evidence.text: In order to evaluate the performance of our hybrid model (CrysCo), for training and testing purposes we used DFT-calculated solid-state properties from the MP21 database4.
To benchmark CrysCo’s performance, we used 8 properties datasets (Table 1) that include material compositions, crystal structures, and tabulated physical and chemical descriptors as inputs.
In this study, we use 9 datasets obtained from the Materials Project database (MP21).
We use The Materials Project63 dataset in this work.
